summary: Idempotent release standing-state init/repair (#320): diagnose healthy|never_initialized|drifted; create missing release-major/minor/patch/release; ensure one Next Release issue; report need:human on duplicates; CLI gh plate release repair|init + MCP plate_release_repair.
migration_impact: New repair path. Does not force-delete branches or auto-close extra Next Release issues. Complements bootstrap --apply (still valid for full bootstrap).
migration_guidance: 2. gh plate release repair (dry-run) to see missing tracks / Next Release drift.
3. gh plate release repair --apply (or release init --apply) to create missing branches/issue.
4. If multiple Next Release issues exist, human closes extras — tool will not auto-dedupe.
agent_notes: Addresses legacy-mode warning when track branches missing. Prefer dry-run first. Closes #320.
